{{Top|leg}}
A '''mass coupler''' was a part used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. It was also useful as a trade item.

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] needed a mass coupler to fix his [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]] before the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was able to obtain one by either trading an [[engine binder]] and a [[Hydrospanner/Legends|hydrospanner]] to [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]], two [[fuel converter]]s to the [[Important Merchant]], or a [[Naboo Fusion Coil]] and an [[engine binder]] to the Important Merchant.

Qui-Gon could also obtain the mass coupler by killing the Important Merchant or Mawhonic and stealing it from them, but Anakin would then refuse to accept it.
